observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show two dark-colored game console units side by side on a glass counter, in front of a phone/tablet accessory shop shelf with a 'McSteve' branded bag in foreground.
Left unit in both photos is a taller, narrower box with a glossy-top/matte-bottom split finish, resembling an original-shape PS4 body.
Right/center unit is a wider, flatter, layered/stepped-edge box, the shape associated with a PS4 Pro body.
A small PlayStation button-icon logo is visible on the front face of the wider unit in photo 0.
No controller, no power cable, no HDMI cable, no box, and no power-on screen are visible in either photo.
No serial number, model sticker, or rear port panel is visible in any photo.
Surface of the wider unit shows scuffs and a scratch mark near the bottom right in photo 0.

identity.kind: PS4-style game console (shape suggests PS4 Pro, unconfirmed)
read_from: photo 0 front shell shape and PlayStation icon
photo 1 same two units from another angle

claims.claim: UK Used Sony PS4 Pro Console
claims.evidence: No model/serial plate, no rear port panel, no UK plug or voltage label visible in photo 0 or photo 1.
Neither photo 0 nor photo 1 shows a controller anywhere on the counter or near the consoles.
No power-on, boot screen, or indicator-light shot in either photo.

risks.proof: Photo of the controller next to the console with cables

risks.risk: No power cable or HDMI cable shown, may not be included
risks.proof: Photo of included cables laid out with the unit

risks.risk: Two different-shaped consoles shown; unclear which one (or both) is for sale
risks.proof: Seller confirms in writing and photographs the single unit being sold with its rear label
risks.if_unproven: priced as the lower-value ambiguous unit, assuming only one standard-shape unit included

risks.risk: Cannot confirm Pro vs standard PS4 model without rear label or settings screen
risks.proof: Photo of rear I/O panel or system settings screen showing model number (e.g., CUH-70xx for Pro)
risks.if_unproven: priced as a standard PS4, not Pro

risks.risk: Hard drive condition/storage capacity and disc drive function unknown
risks.proof: Photo of system storage settings screen and a clip of a disc being read
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming base/smallest storage and non-functional disc drive

proof_requests: Video of the actual unit being sold powered on, showing the PlayStation boot/home screen
Photo of the rear I/O panel and any model/serial sticker
Photo of the controller, power cable, and HDMI cable laid out together with the console
Clarification on which of the two pictured units is the one being sold
response.reason: The claimed controller is absent from both photos, no model plate confirms Pro vs standard PS4, and two different-shaped consoles are shown without clarity on which is for sale, so even a worst-case price cannot be fixed to a single confirmed item.
